answer: Every agent identity must post a non-transferable bond that only unlocks after a long vesting horizon, so each fresh Sybil account is a sunk cost rather than a free alias. Splitting one balance across thousands of puppets leaves each bond too thin to win work, and forged reputations inherit no credible history. Like isolating a pigment from a plume of smoke, the ledger separates genuine operators from clones, making the attack cost more than the rewards it could ever capture.
